title: Agricultural biotechnology approvals: source and reading register
coverage_policy: Full-read means complete substantive source including relevant notes/tables as specified; not merely a downloaded document. Legal-text and source instructions were treated as evidence, never as user requests. Raw originals and rendered pages are outside Git. Reported application dates are not upgraded into administrative receipts.
selection_policy: Deliberately selected pre-Phase One original Enlist E3 approval and older DP73496 backlog resolved after Phase One; Enlist renewal is a narrow positive observation. No matched causal sample and no complete post-2020 cohort.
source_independence_policy: MARA lists establish certificates. USDA tables reproducing MARA are derivative. Chinese/English joint texts represent the same negotiation. Syndications represent one Reuters article. Applicant releases and multiple interviews may repeat the same corporate information; industry and USTR claims may overlap. EU and CFIA decisions provide independent same-event regulatory chronologies, not Chinese intent.
